description: Character posters, characterart, animated posters, actor art and customizable backdrop rotation for movies and TV shows.
name: ArtworkPlus
overview: Five independent features: rotating character-poster slideshows (movies + TV shows, detail page and library grids), characterart overlays, animated main posters, actor art on person pages (Red Carpet), and a configurable override of Jellyfin's backdrops on detail, library, search and settings pages.
